name: Shaphee lanphee
summary: Shaphee Lanphee is a traditional textile fabric woven and embroidered, usually as a shawl, with embroidered motifs with cotton threads generally by Meitei women of Manipur.
description: Shaphee Lanphee is a traditional textile fabric woven and embroidered, usually as a shawl, with embroidered motifs with cotton threads generally by Meitei women of Manipur. The fabric was, in the past, presented as a gift of honour (Mana Phee) to the soldiers for their bravery in a successful war, and to the praiseworthy chiefs of the indigenous peoples (e.g., Tangkhul, Meitei, Rongmei, etc.) of Manipur by the king of Manipur. It is a product which is protected under the GI registration and is now made throughout  the Indian state  of Manipur.
culturalContext: Registered as a Geographical Indication of India (handicraft, Manipur; registration 2013–14), which protects the name for products made in its place of origin by traditional methods.
